review.change_control: Every added or changed variance requires an explicit RFC 9113 review.

variances.classname: closed: Sends a DATA frame after sending RST_STREAM frame
variances.rationale: RFC 9113 permits minimal processing and discard of frames that raced with a locally sent RST_STREAM; the legacy RFC 7540 timeout expectation is not authoritative for this closure race.

variances.classname: closed: Sends a HEADERS frame after sending RST_STREAM frame
variances.rationale: RFC 9113 permits minimal processing and discard of frames that raced with a locally sent RST_STREAM, including the required header-compression state update for HEADERS.

RFC 9113 allows endpoints to minimally process and discard in-flight DATA on a closed stream while preserving connection flow-control accounting; the legacy timeout expectation is therefore a reviewed variance.

RFC 9113 allows endpoints to minimally process and discard in-flight HEADERS on a closed stream while preserving header-compression state; the legacy timeout expectation is therefore a reviewed variance.

variances.classname: Sends PRIORITY frame that depend on itself
variances.rationale: RFC 9113 deprecates and omits the RFC 7540 priority dependency semantics while retaining the frame format and selected mandatory handling, so the legacy self-dependency expectation is not an RFC 9113 conformance requirement.
